ticket.title: outfeed gate contracts step fails when the member index does not exist yet
ticket.description: outfeed gate -d miter passed fmt, clippy, tests and docs, then failed at contracts with no index at miter/.miter/miter.redb: run miter index first. A Tier 3 gate that needs a manually pre-built index is not runnable from a clean checkout, which is exactly the situation a gate exists for. The step should build the index itself, index into a temporary database, or treat a missing index as a warned skip.
